key_decisions: Vendor's free-tier managed runtime is the deployment (single bundle, no containers / VMs / serverless)
Vendor's free-tier managed-DB with daily snapshot is the RPO; the audit-log table is partitioned by year (5-year retention)
Staging + production (single-tenant per deployment); staging auto-deploys on merge to main; production deploys on manual approval
No IaC (CDK / Terraform / CloudFormation) in U1 — vendor's free-tier runtime configuration is the binding mechanism
No CDN, no DNS, no LB, no Redis, no message broker, no container orchestrator, no WAF — free-tier envelope does not justify them
TLS 1.3 + HSTS are vendor-managed; only egress is to the vendor's two managed services (DB + email gateway)
postgres.js connection pool (max: 5) is shared across U1 + U2-U5 via typed function-calls; the audit_log table is the shared cross-unit resource
Audit-log row IS the log line (no separate console.log for state-mutating actions); vendor's free-tier slow-query dashboard is the binding observability surface
stdout (JSON line) is the secondary log surface for non-state-mutating events; queryable by event and level
No Prometheus / StatsD / OpenTelemetry / Jaeger on the free-tier envelope
SLI set: audit_log INSERT success rate (≥ 99.9 %), audit_log INSERT p95 (≤ 200 ms), audit_log read p95 (≤ 500 ms), 3G page render p95 (≤ 3 s), bootstrap success rate (≥ 99 %)
correlation_id (random(16)) propagated through every typed function-call in a single request; stored in audit_log.correlation_id (the per-request timeline)
Negative position: no PagerDuty / no OpsGenie (free-tier envelope; ≤ 5 staff + ≤ 50 orders/day does not justify an alerting service)
Trunk-based dev (org.md); squash-merge to main with the Bolt slug as the commit message; no release branches
10 build stages (lint, tsc, prettier, bun test, coverage ≥ 80 %, R1.1, R1.2, vite build, bundle-size assertion, mutation discipline) — every stage blocks the merge
Reverse-deploy gates (team.md §Dep-6): a regression in coverage, CI, or the recognition-basis / role-gate / audit-immutability invariants blocks the merge — not just a failed unit test
Staging auto-deploys on merge to main (RTO ≤ 24 h); production deploys on manual approval (OC1 / single-decider)
Rollback is re-deploy the previous artifact (vendor's free-tier keeps the last 5 deploys); code revert is reserved for the rare case where the prior artifact itself is the source of the failure
No feature-flag service on the free-tier envelope; Bolt-by-Bolt deploys + the routes registry + the three-layer gate + audit-log reversals are the natural boundaries
No Vault / no AWS Secrets Manager (free-tier envelope); env vars on the vendor's free-tier runtime are the binding mechanism for DATABASE_URL, SESSION_KEY, EMAIL_KEY
Chrome binary path parameterised (NFR7.6); Playwright 3G profile runs nightly (scheduled CI) for the 3 s p95 budget assertion
